tytul: Labneh balls in olive oil: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for Middle Eastern labneh balls, salted strained yogurt kept in olive oil with za'atar, chili or mint. [T:-]

ostrzezenia.tekst: Low-acid foods stored in oil create an oxygen-free environment that is perfect for the growth of Clostridium botulinum bacteria. [T:MLE-060]
In Canada, the CFIA recalled a labneh in vegetable oil because it may permit the growth of Clostridium botulinum. [T:MLE-062]
Food contaminated with Clostridium botulinum toxin may not look or smell spoiled but can still make you sick. [T:MLE-063]

akapity: The Codex standard lists labneh as a traditional concentrated fermented milk, like strained yogurt. [T:MLE-035]
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for labneh balls in oil from a checked source. [T:-]
